description: Safe-Harbor Token Ban — forbidden AST patterns for Core/Domain layers

tokens.name: raises-catchable-error
tokens.replacement: Use Result[T, E] with enum error type

tokens.name: cast-type-bypass
tokens.replacement: Use typed conversion procs or distinct types

tokens.name: raw-ptr-type
tokens.replacement: Use ref T or ptr T inside {.acyclic.} ref objects

tokens.name: addr-call
tokens.replacement: Pass by var parameter or use unsafeAddr only in {.acyclic.} context

tokens.name: memory-direct-manipulation
tokens.replacement: Use Nim assignment semantics or system.move

tokens.name: heap-direct-management
tokens.replacement: Use seq, string, or managed ref objects

tokens.name: pointer-type
tokens.replacement: Use typed pointers or ref T

tokens.name: global-pragma
tokens.replacement: Inject state via proc parameters or dependency injection

tokens.name: top-level-var-declaration
tokens.replacement: Use proc-local var or pass mutable state via var parameters
